༄༅/ /sdig sgrib kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs/sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa dang ma byon

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sdig sgrib kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs/

sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 7 mdo brgyad brgya par/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs par dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba dang padmas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa la= /sangs rgyas mya ngan med mchog dpal la= /sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho'i mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa la= /sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas bcu par/ sangs rgyas yon tan bskal ba dpag tu med pa las 'das pa la= /sangs rgyas yon tan rin chen bkod pa'i dpal gzi brjid kyi phung po bskal pa la= /sangs rgyas chos thams cad la spobs pa bkod pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas spobs pa dpag tu med pa bkod pa yang dag par spyod pa la= /sangs rgyas spṛn gyi 'brug sgra sgra dbyangs stong pa la= /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i 'od dam pa dpal gyi gzi brjid 'byung ba la= /sangs rgyas rnam pa mang po'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po dpal 'byung ba la= /sangs rgyas bskal pa grangs med par kun tu 'byung ba la= /sangs rgyas dge ba gser gyi nam mkha'i nges par sgrogs pa bkod pa'i dpal gyi gzi brjid 'byung ba la= /sangs rgyas chos thams cad kyi tshul rnam par 'phrul ba'i gzi brjid 'byung ba la=/ / ༈ sangs rgyas brgyad par/ sangs rgyas shin tu yongs su bsgrags pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas shin tu rnam par gnon pa grags mchog dpal la= /sangs rgyas g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba'i rtsal la=

/sangs rgyas yon tan bkod pa'i dpal kun tu snang ba la= /sangs rgyas sman gyi rgyal po dpal thogs pa med pa la= /sangs rgyas rin po che'i padma la rnam par gnon pas bzhud pa la= /sangs rgyas rin po che'i padma la rab tu gnas pa sā la'i rgyal po la=// // bkra shis brgyad par/ sangs rgyas sgron ma'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas rtsal brtan don grub dgongs pa la= /sangs rgyas kun la dgongs pa rgya cher grags pa can la= /sangs rgyas byams pa'i brgyad pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas dge bar grags pa dpal la= /sangs rgyas lhun po ltar 'phags pa rtsal rab grags pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad la dgongs pa grags pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas yid tshim par mdzad pa rtsal rab grags pa'i dpal la=/ / dra ba can gyis zhus par/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'od zer zla bas brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid dbyangs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas me tog 'od kyis rnam par rol bas mngon par mkhyen pa la= /sangs rgyas me tog rgyas pa sā la'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam dag la= /sangs rgyas rab tu zhi ba mkhas pa gzi brjid kyi dbyangs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas brtson 'grus grangs med pas yang dag par rab tu gnas pa la/ / sprin chen por/ sangs rgyas blo gros mi zad pa la= /sangs rgyas rin chen rgyal mtshan la= /sangs rgyas 'od dri ma med pa'i snying po la= /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pas dang bas byed pa'i grags pa la= /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsrungs la= /sangs rgyas sedge rnam par rol ba'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas lhun po'i rgyal po mngon par 'phags la= /sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos kun tu srung ba'i tog tu gyur pa la=// phyaugs bcu'i mun sel nas/ sangs rgyas rjes su skyong ba la= /sangs rgyas sems dang po bskyed pa yid la mdzad pa rnam grangs bsnyengs pa dang bag tsha ba dang bral bas mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po la=

/sangs rgyas kho na dang rgyags pa rnam par gnon pa la= /sangs rgyas rin chen gzugs bkod 'od snang la= /sangs rgyas bdud dang yid gnyis kun 'joms rnam par gnon pa la= /sangs rgyas sems dang po bskyed pas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo 'byung ba'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas rin chen gdugs 'phags snang la= /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba la= /sangs rgyas skrag med mun bral ting nge 'dzin mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas dang po sems bskyed pa the tshom gcod mdzad nyon mongs bskyod la= /khye'u rin chen zla ba'i mdor/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang po la= /sangs rgyas tsan dan dpal la= /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la= /sangs rgyas tog gi dpal la= /sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas rin po che'i mchod sdong la= /sangs rgyas me tog dpal la= /sangs rgyas mngon par shes pa chung dang 'bring dang chen pos rnam par rol ba la= /sangs rgyas snang ba'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas nor dpal la= /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dpal la=// me tog tshogs kyi mdor/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas la= / sangs rgyas rin chen dam pa la= /sangs rgyas rin chen snang ba la= /sangs rgyas rin chen tog la= /sangs rgyas rin chen rab snang la= /sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la= /sangs rgyas 'od chen po la= /sangs rgyas dbyangs dpag med la= / sangs rgyas bdud rtsi dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas grags pa chen po la= /sangs rgyas grags pa mtha' yas la= /sangs rgyas rin chen snang ba la= /sangs rgyas bde ba chen po thob la= /sangs rgyas skar ma mar me snang ba la= /sangs rgyas bden ba'i dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas dri med mtha' yas la= /sangs rgyas zla ba ltar dkar ba la= /sangs rgyas zla 'od la= /sangs rgyas dri ma med pa'i 'od la= /sangs rgyas 'od dag pa la=/sangs rgyas nyi 'od la= /sangs rgyas rin chen mtha' yas la= /sangs rgyas padmo bla ma la= /sangs rgyas yan lag bla ma la= /sangs rgyas gser 'od dam pa la=

/sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i dbang phyug rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas gser ltar snang ba la= /sangs rgyas gser gyi 'byung gnas la= /sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas me tog thams cad kyi dri'i dbang phyug rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas sā la'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas brtan pa'i sde mtshon chas nyon mongs pa sel ba la= /sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po snang ba la= /sangs rgyas spos dpag med snang ba la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas mthu chen po brtson 'grus kyis nges par 'byung bas snying po zil gyis gnon pa la= /sangs rgyas rda dbyangs rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas zla ba'i bla ma la= /sangs rgyas me tog zil gyis gnon pa la= /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi sgron me la= /sangs rgyas me la= /sangs rgyas rin po che'i rmad la= /sangs rgyas zug rngu med pa'i blo la= /sangs rgyas sprul pa tshad med par snang ba la= /sangs rgyas ri rab rnam par gnon pa la= /sangs rgyas rin po che'i glang po dam pa la= /sangs rgyas rin chen 'dul ba'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo rin chen rtag tu don dpal la= /sangs rgyas kun tu rnam par snang mdzad rnam par dag pa thob pa la= /sangs rgyas nyi zla sgron ma la= /sangs rgyas ri rab ces bya la= /sangs rgyas ri rab mngon pa la= /sangs rgyas ri rab 'dra ba la= /sangs rgyas kun tu spos la= /sangs rgyas snang ba yongs su dag pa la= /sangs rgyas chos kyi bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas spos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas yon tan chen po la= /sangs rgyas spos 'od la= /sangs rgyas 'od 'phro la= /sangs rgyas 'od tshad med la= /sangs rgyas 'od btang ba la= /sangs rgyas zla ba'i sgron ma la= /sangs rgyas zla 'od la= /sangs rgyas zla ba snang la= /sangs rgyas me 'od la= /sangs rgyas rnam par rgyal ba'i snang la= /sangs rgyas mchog mdzad la= /sangs rgyas mang po'i bla ma la=

/sangs rgyas padma'i sde la= /sangs rgyas padmo'i dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas rin chen mang la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i nga ro la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas dpa' bo'i sde la= /sangs rgyas yang dag par blangs pa thams cad las brgal ba the tshom gcod pa la= /sangs rgyas 'khor rin po che dang me lta bu la= /sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa la= /sangs rgyas dam pa'i dga' ston la= /sangs rgyas dbang po'i 'byung gnas la= /sangs rgyas dbyangs tshad med pa la phyag= /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la= /sangs rgyas rin po che snang ba la= /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la= /sangs rgyas rnam par rgyal ba mnga' ba la= /sangs rgyas rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po brtsegs pa rnam par bsgrags pa'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas rdo rjes rab tu 'joms pa la= /sangs rgyas rin chen me la= /sangs rgyas zla ba'i 'od la= / sangs rgyas bzang po dam pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas padmo la bzhud pa la= /sangs rgyas gser snang bas rnam par gnon pa la= /sangs rgyas ma pham pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas tshad med pa'i bla ma la= /sangs rgyas ma brlan pa'i glang po dam pa la= /sangs rgyas brtson 'grus grangs med pa la bzhugs pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas dgongs pa brjod kyi mi lang ba la= /sangs rgyas gti mug med pa'i spos dpal la= /sangs rgyas zla ba dpal la= /sangs rgyas rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'od la= /sangs rgyas nam mkha' snang ba la= /sangs rgyas spyod pa yongs su dag pa'i tog la= /sangs rgyas gter legs par gnas pa'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas don thams cad grub pa la= /sangs rgyas shes rab kyis sbaid pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas gtam shin tu yongs su dag par mdzad pa la= /sangs rgyas baiḍūrya'i snying po la= /sangs rgyas yon tan shin tu yongs su dag par rab tu gnas pa la= /sangs rgyas rin chen snang bas rnam par gnon pa'i mchod rten la= /sangs rgyas tshad med pa'i khrel yod pa gser dam pa'i dpal la=/

sangs rgyas padma dam pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas rin chen dag pa 'byung ba'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas glog gi sgron ma tog gi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas ta la'i rgyal po mngon par 'phags pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas chos nam mkha'i sgron ma la= /sangs rgyas yon tan thams cad 'byung ba la= /sangs rgyas bzang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa la=// thar pa chen po nas 'byung ba'i mtshan 'ga' zhig ni/ sangs rgyas mar me gsal nyi khri la= /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad sum khri la= /sangs rgyas 'od mi g.yo ba 'bum phrag brgya la= /sangs rgyas gsal rgyal 'bum phrag bcu la= /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa 'bum phrag brgya la= /sangs rgyas dbang phyug thob pa'i rgyal po 'bum phrag brgya la= /sangs rgyas 'od kyi mtshan mas rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyal po nyi khri la= /sangs rgyas kun tu dpal sum khri la= /sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba brgyad khri bzhi stong la= /sangs rgyas 'od zer rnam par bkod pa 'bum phrag brgyad cu la= /sangs rgyas lung bstan pa padma'i 'od lnga brgya la=/ /gzhan yang mdo sde mang por/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa la= /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la= /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan la= /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la= /sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la= / sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la= /sangs rgyas gtsug tor can la= / sangs rgyas thams cad skyob la= /sangs rgyas log par dad sel la= /sangs rgyas gser thub la= /sangs rgyas 'od srung la= /sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro la= /sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po la= /sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas padmo dam pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas gdugs dam pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa sde gdab pa'i rgyal po la=

/sangs rgyas sā la'i dbang po'i me tog rab tu rgyas pa la= /sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po la= /sangs rgyas utpal rgyas pa bsung gi tog gi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas rdo rje snying pos rab tu 'dul ba la= /sangs rgyas rab tu gdon mi za bar padmo rgyas pa'i sku la= /sangs rgyas sedge la= /sangs rgyas rin po che'i gtsug phud la= /sangs rgyas chos kyi 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa'i sku la= /sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i blo gros 'od zer gyi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas zla ba'i thugs la= /sangs rgyas dpal bzang po la= /sangs rgyas mdzes chen la= /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi dkyil 'khor dbang po'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas dga' ba'i spyan la=/sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas gser gyi gzu ba la= /sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa'i yon tan 'od zer la= /sangs rgyas smon lam thams cad 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gzi brjid shin tu 'phags pa'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas grags pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas ye shes rdo rje'i rgya mtsho'i dbang po la= /sangs rgyas kun gzigs la= /sangs rgyas 'od zhi spos snang dpal la= /sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po la= / gzhan yang sangs rgyas gcig dang bcu dang brgya dang stong dang khri dang 'bum dang bye ba khrag khrig gadgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed grangs med pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /theg pa gsum gyi sde snod thams cad la= /gang zhig chags pa dang bral pa 'gog pa'i bden pa dang*/ gang gis chags pa dang bral ba lam gyi bden pas bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ༈ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag= /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la= /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la= /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la=

/byang chub sems dpa' sa yi snyingapo la= /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la= /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la= /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes bla ma la=/byang chub sems dpa' 'od kyi tog la= /byang chub sems dpa' dbang po zhi ba la= /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa la= /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la= /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho la= /byang chub sems dpa' dra ba can gyi 'od la= /byang chub sems dpa' 'od dpag med la= /byang chub sems dpa' spo ba brtsegs pa la= /byang chub sems dpal mya ngan dang mun pa nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros la= /byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba don yod la= /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po la= /byang chub sems dpa' ngan song kun 'dren la= /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bar 'gro ba la= /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes tog la= /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba'i 'od la= /byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong la= /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la= /byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nu la= /byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med par grags pa la= /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po la= /byang chub sems dpa' sedge'i tog la= /byang chub sems dpa' don grub blo gros la= /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa rab tu zhi ba'i blo gros la= /byang chub sems dpa' so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa la= /byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus rtag par sbyor la= /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje cher sems la= /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes tog gi rgyal mtshan la= /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa chos 'phags la= /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu nguu la= /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad la= /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs med la= /byang chub sems dpa' thogs med la= /byang chub sems dpa' stobs dpag med la /byang chub sems dpa' khams gsum 'phags la=

/byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la= /rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos kyi tshogs thams cad la= /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas phyogs bcu na bdag pos bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i lha dang mi'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang*/ bdag gis lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa 'bul zhing mchod do/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis skye ba thams cad du 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis nyes pa'i tshogs ci bgyis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags so/ /slan chad kyang mi bgyid do/ /rang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /de dag thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba kun kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /de'i mthus bdag 'di nas shi 'phos te bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skyes nas ji ltar 'phags pa kun tu bzang po dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i spyod pa ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar bdag gis spyad de mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na'ang 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i mdzad pa phun sum tshogs pa ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyi don ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sgrub par gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i phan yon ni/ gnas skabs su nad gdon gyis mi tshugs pa dang*/ ngan song las thar pa dang*/ sangs rgyas de dag gi zhing du skye ba dang*/ sangs rgyas de rnams dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa dang*/ mthar sangs rgyas nyid myur du 'thob par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa mdo de dang de las gsungs pas mos pa'i blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis don che la nyen chung ba 'di la 'bad par bya zhing yid ches par bya ba'i phyir mdo de rnams la'ang blta bar bya'o/

/de lta bu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan ni rab 'byams smra ba grags pa bshad sgrub kyis rang gzhan spy-i dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba mang po la phan par 'gyur pa snying nas bsams te mdo de dang de dag las btus nas bkod pa'o// //'di sngar par thung gi grwar bzhugs pa las/ ༈ rje nyid zhi bar gshegs pa la nye bar phyogs pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan 'di dag kyang nang du bcug la gsung 'bum gyi grwar chud par gyis shig ces rang gi slob ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang*/ tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub gnyis la brtse ba'i lta stangs dang bcas gsung gi tha mas gdams pa spyi bor blangs te de gnyis kyis bar du bsgrubs pa'o/ /dge ba 'dis kyang tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun bla ma dam pas rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i tshe 'khor gyi thog mar skye bar gyur cig / /madgalaṃ/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/sdig sgrib kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 266--PAGE 267--PAGE 256-
